{{Quote|Take him!|The bailiff, commanding [[Coastal defender stormtrooper|shoretroopers]]|<ref name="Announcement" />}}
A member of the [[Lacertilo]] [[species]] served as a '''bailiff''' to an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Unidentified judge|judge]] in the [[Niamos Courthouse|Courthouse]] on [[Niamos]]<ref name="Announcement">{{Andor|Announcement}}</ref> around [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]" take place shortly after "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," which dates itself to [[5 BBY]].</ref> The bailiff was present when the judge sentenced [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]—under the alias of Keef Girgo—to six [[Standard year|years]] of [[Prison|detention]].<ref name="Announcement" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character first appeared in "[[Announcement]]", the seventh episode of the live action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', where they were portrayed by [[Aidan Cook]], who also portrayed a [[Unidentified KX-series security droid (Niamos)|KX-series security droid]] in the episode.<ref name="Announcement" />
